hero.subtitle: We help companies enter new markets, find reliable business partners and develop sustainable commercial relationships between Türkiye and Eurasia.

services.heading: Our Services
services.subheading: Everything you need to enter, grow and succeed across Eurasian markets.

items.title: Market Entry
items.description: Enter new markets with confidence. We provide local insights and practical support to launch your business the right way.

items.title: Local Representation
items.description: We represent your company locally and act in your best interest when you cannot be on the ground yourself.

items.title: Distributor & Buyer Search
items.description: We find the right distributors, importers and buyers for your products through our trusted regional network.

items.title: B2B Matchmaking
items.description: We connect you with relevant partners and organize focused B2B meetings that move deals forward.

items.title: Market Research
items.description: We provide sector, competitor and pricing research to support your strategy with hard data, not guesses.

items.title: Business Development
items.description: From the first contact to commercial agreements, we are with you at every stage of growing your business.

left.title: TÜRKİYE → EURASIA
left.paragraph: We help Turkish manufacturers and exporters identify opportunities, establish local partnerships and develop sales channels across Eurasian markets.

right.title: EURASIA → TÜRKİYE
right.paragraph: We support companies from Eurasia seeking reliable partners, buyers and distribution channels in Türkiye's large and growing consumer market.
